6 تماسّا They (two bodies) touched each other; were, or became, in contact. (M, A, * K, *) ―
-b2- Hence, (K,) (tropical:) They two came together in the way of مُبَاضَعَة: (S, Msb, * K: *) in this sense the verb is used in the Kur, lviii. 4 and 5. (S, TA.) See also مَسَّهَا.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
